name: Uaxaclajuun Ubʼaah Kʼawiil
contribution: The 13th ajaw or ruler of the powerful Maya polity associated with the site of Copán in modern Honduras.

checks.lead: Uaxaclajuun Ubʼaah Kʼawiil (also known as "Eighteen Rabbit" or "Waxaklajuun Ub'aah K'awiil"), was the 13th ajaw or ruler of the powerful Maya polity associated with the site of Copán in modern Honduras (its Classic Maya name was probably Oxwitik). He ruled from January 2, 695, to May 3, 738.
